title: A Familiar Voice
transcript:
Dark water. Sunlight somewhere above it, broken into pieces.
Two boys laughing, the sound bent by the surface.
A small wet hand lands on his shoulder.

RAMAN:
"Again. You always forget the pattern."

He counts it out on his fingers, patient, as if for the hundredth time:

2 - 7 - 1 - 8

PARTH:
"Raman...?"

The water closes over the name.
